15 /-!
16 # `NeZero` typeclass
17 
18 We create a typeclass `NeZero n` which carries around the fact that `(n : R) ≠ 0`.
19 
20 ## Main declarations
21 
22 * `NeZero`: `n ≠ 0` as a typeclass.
23 -/
24 
25 
26 variable {R : Type _} [Zero R]
27 
28 /-- A type-class version of `n ≠ 0`.  -/
29 class NeZero (n : R) : Prop where
30   /-- The proposition that `n` is not zero. -/
31   out : n ≠ 0
32 
33 theorem NeZero.ne (n : R) [h : NeZero n] : n ≠ 0 :=
34   h.out
35 
36 theorem NeZero.ne' (n : R) [h : NeZero n] : 0 ≠ n :=
37   h.out.symm
38 
39 theorem neZero_iff {n : R} : NeZero n ↔ n ≠ 0 :=
40   ⟨fun h ↦ h.out, NeZero.mk⟩
41 
42 @[simp] theorem neZero_zero_iff_false {α : Type _} [Zero α] : NeZero (0 : α) ↔ False :=
43   ⟨fun _ ↦ NeZero.ne (0 : α) rfl, fun h ↦ h.elim⟩
44 
45 instance {p : Prop} [Decidable p] {n m : Nat} [NeZero n] [NeZero m] :
46     NeZero (if p then n else m) := by
47   split <;> infer_instance
48 
49 instance {n m : Nat} [h : NeZero n] : NeZero (n + m) where
50   out :=
51     match n, h, m with
52     | _ + 1, _, 0
53     | _ + 1, _, _ + 1 => fun h => nomatch h
54 
55 instance {n m : Nat} [h : NeZero m] : NeZero (n + m) where
56   out :=
57     match m, h, n with
58     | _ + 1, _, 0 => fun h => nomatch h
59     | _ + 1, _, _ + 1 => fun h => nomatch h
60 
61 instance {n m : Nat} [hn : NeZero n] [hm : NeZero m] : NeZero (n * m) where
62   out :=
63     match n, hn, m, hm with
64     | _ + 1, _, _ + 1, _ => fun h => nomatch h
